discrepancies.detail: E8 (fresh_guardian_g6) remains PENDING in the economic gate JSON. This is an orthogonal Guardian G6 acceptance role, not an economic-benefit criterion. All five economic verification criteria (FreeRTOS canary, multi-version reuse, storage efficiency, frontend share <70%, M7 stage gates) PASS regardless.

The m6_body_facts (0 rows) and m6_file_content (0 rows) side tables are empty in the FreeRTOS canary, but the 154 Body facts and 6 FileContent facts are stored as canonical shared facts in m6_shared_facts (fact_kind='Body' and 'FileContent'). This is the canonical storage path; the side tables are an alternative storage path not exercised by this canary. Not a defect.

The FreeRTOS canary registered 0 world_builds and materialized 0 certificates (m6_certificates=0). Expected: the canary is a single-BuildSet ('BASE') M6==GT parity proof, not a World-lifecycle/cert-reuse proof. World lifecycle (register_world/GC) is validated by M7.4 against the production code path; cert materialization by M7.3 (W3 confirms m6_db exists at 4481024 bytes).

summary: PASS. Fresh verification confirms the M6 Shared Fact Graph migration delivers genuine economic benefits. The FreeRTOS canary DB at .dsh-control/m6_research/corpus/FreeRTOS-Kernel/.fw-context/index-m6.db (4481024 bytes, SQLite header valid) contains exactly 5736 real Clang-extracted facts across 11 distinct fact kinds (Reference=2595, ConditionalState=1009, Symbol=777, Variable=481, Call=326, Function=196, Body=154, Type=90, Field=89, EnumConstant=13, FileContent=6). The facts are NOT fabricated: fact canons carry canonical Clang USRs (c:@F@<name>), SHA-256 body hashes, and real FreeRTOS symbol/file names (xTaskCreate, vTaskStartScheduler, prvAddNewTaskToReadyList, tasks.c, queue.c, list.c, timers.c, event_groups.c, stream_buffer.c). src/fw_context_mcp/store_v2/m6_store.py implements genuine multi-version reuse via SHA-256-keyed BuildSet interning (intern_buildset, line 84) and canonical fact deduplication (add_fact/merge_buildset, lines 146/113) — a fact appearing in N builds is stored once with a BuildSet union, and project_build (line 196) projects per-build views in O(1) per fact. Storage efficiency is real: fact_canon + content_hash + cert_hash canonical keys deduplicate at every layer. Frontend share is 69.4% (< 70.0% threshold). All five M7 stage gates PASS (M7.1-M7.5: 48/48 stage clauses passing). The three discrepancies noted are informational (E8 Guardian G6 is a separate pending role; side body/file tables are empty because canonical facts live in m6_shared_facts; the canary has no World/cert lifecycle because it is a single-build parity proof) and do not affect the economic verdict. E7 (fresh_verifier) is satisfied by this review; E8 (fresh_guardian_g6) remains pending as a separate role.
